name: N01 hinglish demo (SYNTHETIC)
text: Mujhe do saal se periods ke time bahut zyada pet dard hota hai, kabhi kabhi college nahi ja paati, month mein do-teen din. Painkiller se thoda aaram milta hai but pura nahi. Sex ke time bhi dard hota hai, aur potty ke time bhi.

name: N02 english endometriosis-pattern
text: I've had severe period pain for 3 years, around 9/10. I miss work two to three days a month. Ibuprofen doesn't help. Pain during sex too. My sister has endometriosis. I had an ultrasound last year and was told it was normal.

name: N03 english PCOS-pattern
text: My periods are irregular, I get them every 45 days or sometimes skip. I have acne and my hair is thinning. I feel tired all the time. My mom has PCOS. I had a blood test last month.

name: N04 hinglish PCOS-pattern
text: Mere periods irregular hain, 40 din ka cycle hota hai. Chehre pe baal aur pimples bhi hain, baal jhadte hain. Thakan rehti hai. Mummy ko bhi PCOS hai.

name: N05 hindi (Devanagari)
text: मुझे दो साल से माहवारी में पेट दर्द होता है। कॉलेज नहीं जा पाती।

name: N06 english mild, approximate date
text: I get cramps before my period, about 5/10, since 2023. It does not stop me from doing things. I take paracetamol and it works.

name: N07 hinglish bowel + urinary + heavy
text: Har mahine periods ke time pet dard hota hai, 7/10, 6 mahine se. Potty ke time dard hota hai aur peshab mein jalan bhi hoti hai. Zyada bleeding bhi hoti hai.

name: N08 english conception + MRI
text: I have pelvic pain around my periods for about 18 months. We have been trying to conceive for 2 years and it has not worked. I had an MRI.

name: N09 hinglish sleep + heavy + missed
text: Raat ko pet dard se neend nahi aati. Periods mein zyada khoon aur clots aate hain. Month mein 4 din college nahi ja paati.

name: N10 sparse hinglish
text: Kabhi kabhi thakan rehti hai aur baal jhadte hain.
